summary: Join our Risk-Based Capital Adequacy Framework Training to gain critical insights and tools for effective capital management in today's financial landscape.
lede: Internal capital adequacy training helps bank professionals connect capital resources to measured risks and support explainable capital planning. It equips practitioners to calculate capital ratios and risk-weighted assets, assess credit, market and operational risk, and develop stress-testing matrices. They also review data lineage, governance controls and Pillar 3 disclosures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who calculate, challenge, govern, report, or make decisions about bank capital and risk-weighted assets. It suits experienced practitioners who already work with financial risk, prudential reporting, treasury, audit, or enterprise risk processes.
modules: Market Risk Capital and Trading Books
prerequisites: You should bring practical experience with banking risk or capital processes and basic spreadsheet skills. No coding background is required. TrainingCred provides prepared exposure data, capital calculation templates, stress-testing scenarios, control checklists, and reference materials. Laptop use is recommended for Excel and dashboard exercises.
